releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.40 — the wiring audit. Calls were never really wired: the call screen was an animation that said "connected" after 1.6 seconds, the other phone never rang, and answering was impossible. Calls now follow the real protocol — your phone rings with Answer/Decline, the caller sees Declined or a live timer, and both sides get a History row. Also fixed: status views never reached the server (viewer counts stayed at zero), the other side never saw you recording a voice note, and the name shown for "is typing" in a group was a guess. Group-chat calls are now labelled as unavailable instead of opening a screen that could not connect. Call audio/video itself is the next release — the call screen says so rather than pretending the line is live. New: docs/BACKEND-WIRING.md lists every backend route and what in the app answers it.
